what_it_changes: Add a bounded genuine-model retention evaluation that acquires explicit workspace memory/procedure state, reconstructs only that persisted state into a fresh agent instance, requires recall/reuse without re-learning or re-adoption, and reruns protected transfer/robustness checks.
applicability: bounded genuine-model continual-learning validation after a stable workspace campaign
non_applicability: unbounded retries or duplicate live requests

supporting_evidence.finding: PR 165 exact head 6103859360fe188fa61e509b0916743d4e6c9c3e passed full repository CI run 32090123069. Deterministic tests prove a fresh agent can consume explicitly reconstructed state, protected transfer/robustness remain passing, and redundant remember/adopt events are rejected even when outputs remain correct.
